model_system: tetragonal ferroelectric BaTiO3 (BTO), clamped Pockels tensor; 2×2×1 supercell with local Ti off-centering along ⟨110⟩

key_params.xc_functional: PBEsol (highlighted as enabling stabilization beyond LDA)
key_params.electric_field_treatment: modern theory of polarization with electric-enthalpy functional
key_params.response_terms: electronic + optical-phonon ionic contributions; strain/piezoelectric contribution neglected (clamped film)
key_params.derivatives: automated first- and second-order finite differences of polarizations and Hellmann-Feynman forces

headline_claim: Largest clamped Pockels coefficient r51 of tetragonal BTO is recovered in the correct experimental range, consistent with about 730 ± 150 pm/V
replication_difficulty: high - requires coupled finite-field and finite-displacement DFT workflow plus stabilization of soft modes via supercell/local Ti off-centering and careful XC/PP choice
